text: Amid the fanfare of trumpets, the piercing notes of a steam caliope, the prancing of horses, the squealing of monkeys and the roaring of lions, Jackie Coogan runs away and joins a circus in his latest picture, "Circus Days," which comes to the Queen's Theatre to-day for an engagement of five days.

label: text
text: Heralded as the finest picture that the inimitable Jackie has yet made, it is the sort of story that should appeal to every boy or girl—young or old.

label: text
text: Driven from home and his widowed mother, Toby Tyler, the youthful hero played by the star, starts his adventures under the "big top" as a peanut salesman.
